mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `session_boundary_pair` ( `id` BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '自增主键 ID', `parent_conversation_id` VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '所属原始对话 ID（关联 chat_session.parent_conversation_id）', `pair_index` INT NOT NULL COMMENT '对话内 Pair 顺序序号（1-indexed，保证顺序性）', `message_a_id` VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '前一条消息 ID 或内容哈希', `message_b_id` VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '后一条消息 ID 或内容哈希', `message_a_role` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '前一条消息角色（user / assistant）', `message_b_role` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '后一条消息角色（user / assistant）', `message_a_text` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '前一条消息完整文本正文（含 Markdown 图片与文本）', `message_b_text` TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT '后一条消息完整文本正文（含 Markdown 图片与文本）', `has_attachment` TINYINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否包含图片或文件附件（1是/0否）', `attachment_meta_a` TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '消息 A 关联的全量附件元数据列表（JSON 数组）', `attachment_meta_b` TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '消息 B 关联的全量附件元数据列表（JSON 数组）', `l1_score` DECIMAL(6,4) NOT NULL COMMENT 'L1 BGE 向量余弦相似度得分', `l1_zone` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL COMMENT 'L1 大区（GREEN_MERGE / FUZZY / RED_SPLIT）', `l2_verdict` VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 裁决（MERGE / SPLIT），仅 FUZZY 区有值', `l2_confidence` VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 置信度（HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW）', `l2_reason` VARCHAR(512) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 裁决推导说明', `l2_model` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 调用的 AI 大模型名称', `l1_audit_status` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNCHECKED' COMMENT 'L1 人工核对状态', `l1_audit_verdict` VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L1 人工判定结论', `l1_audit_time` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L1 人工核对时间戳', `l2_audit_status` VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNCHECKED' COMMENT 'L2 人工核对状态', `l2_audit_verdict` VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 人工判定结论', `l2_audit_time` DATETIME DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 人工核对时间戳', `manual_remark` VARCHAR(256) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '人工复核备注说明', `final_decision` VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '最终决策（MERGE / SPLIT）', `process_status` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' COMMENT '处理状态（PENDING / DONE / NEED_MANUAL_REVIEW）', `create_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间', `update_time` DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间', PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `uk_conv_pair` (`parent_conversation_id`, `pair_index`), KEY `idx_parent_conv_id` (`parent_conversation_id`), KEY `idx_process_status` (`process_status`), KEY `idx_l1_zone_score` (`l1_zone`, `l1_score`), KEY `idx_has_attachment` (`has_attachment`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='会话切分消息边界决策过程表';
ALTER TABLE `session_boundary_pair` ADD COLUMN `l2_model` VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'L2 调用的 AI 大模型名称';
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `session_boundary_pair` WHERE `parent_conversation_id` = #{parentConversationId} ORDER BY `pair_index` ASC
SELECT * FROM `session_boundary_pair` WHERE `process_status` = 'PENDING' ORDER BY `id` ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalFuzzy, SUM(CASE WHEN `has_attachment` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalFuzzyImages, SUM(CASE WHEN `has_attachment` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalFuzzyText, SUM(CASE WHEN `l2_verdict` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalJudged, SUM(CASE WHEN `l2_verdict` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalPending, SUM(CASE WHEN `l2_verdict` = 'MERGE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalMerge, SUM(CASE WHEN `l2_verdict` = 'SPLIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalSplit, SUM(CASE WHEN `process_status` = 'NEED_MANUAL_REVIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalReview FROM `session_boundary_pair` WHERE `l1_zone` = 'FUZZY'
SELECT * FROM `session_boundary_pair` WHERE `l1_audit_status` != 'UNCHECKED' ORDER BY `l1_audit_time` DESC, `update_time` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM `session_boundary_pair` WHERE `process_status` = 'NEED_MANUAL_REVIEW' ORDER BY `id` ASC
